raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 5, the Planner incorrectly deduced that the paternal grandmother was "Princess Maria Antonia of the Two Sicilies." The WebSurfer result immediately preceding this (Step 4) explicitly stated that Leopold Salvator was the son of "Archduke Karl Salvator of Austria and Princess Maria Immaculata of Bourbon-Two Sicilies." The Planner failed to correctly identify Maria Immaculata as the mother (and thus the paternal grandmother) and instead hallucinated or confused the lineage with Maria Antonia (who was actually the mother of Karl Salvator, making her Dolores's paternal great-grandmother). This erroneous conclusion was then carried forward despite subsequent searches confirming Maria Immaculata.
